# 2026 AI SaaS Landing Page Playbook + brocco.ai Site Spec

## 1. Hero Section — what 2026 winners do

**Pattern:** One bold headline (under 12 words), one specific subhead, ONE primary CTA + one quiet secondary, product shown in motion (animated UI, not a YouTube embed), no nav distractions.

| Site | Headline | Primary CTA | Motion |
|---|---|---|---|
| [linear.app](https://linear.app) | "The product development system for teams and agents" | "Get started" | Animated UI showing Codex agent working an issue |
| [vercel.com](https://vercel.com) | "Build and deploy on the AI Cloud." | "Deploy" / "Start Deploying" | Static + perf-metric vignettes (Runway 7m→40s) |
| [cursor.com](https://cursor.com) | "Built to make you extraordinarily productive…" | "Download for macOS" | Static IDE screenshot |
| [lovable.dev](https://lovable.dev) | "Build something Lovable" | Inline prompt box ("Send message") | The hero IS the product — chat input |
| [relevanceai.com](https://www.relevanceai.com) | "Scale GTM results, without scaling headcount" | "Try for free" / "Talk to sales" | Live agent dialogue snippet |

Winners in 2026 do NOT autoplay YouTube videos. They run looping silent UI captures (Linear, Vercel) or — best-in-class — make the hero itself an interactive try-it surface (Lovable).

## 2. Above-the-fold proof

What converts: (a) 3-6 logos with a single quantified result per logo, NOT a wall of 30 grayscale logos; (b) one named human testimonial with company; (c) a count metric ("25,000 product teams" — Linear). Logos alone are dead weight unless backed by a result. Vercel pairs Runway/Leonardo/Zapier with a number each. Linear puts named quotes from OpenAI/Ramp/Opendoor in the hero.

## 3. Agent/feature showcase — patterns to copy

- **Linear:** real animated UI of the agent doing the thing (Codex running on an issue). The agent is shown as a teammate in the existing UI, not a chat box.
- **Vercel:** "Your product, delivered" — three pillars (Agents / AI Apps / Web Apps) each with a discrete card and visual.
- **Lovable:** prompt → result as the hero. The fastest "I get it" moment of any site in this set.
- **Cursor:** scrolling tier of named customer quotes (Karpathy, Collison, Brockman) doubles as feature copy.
- **Relevance AI:** persona vignettes ("Sarah Chen, AE, follows up with stalled deals") — show the JOB the agent does, not the architecture.

Pattern to copy: scroll-triggered "agent in flight" — show input, show tool calls happening, show output. Loops in 8–12 sec.

## 4. Pricing section

Consensus 4-tier ladder (Free → Pro → Team/Business → Enterprise). [Linear pricing](https://linear.app/pricing): $0 / $10 / $16 (most popular) / Custom. [Cursor pricing](https://cursor.com/pricing): Free / $20 / $60 (Recommended) / $200 / $40 Teams / Custom. [Vercel pricing](https://vercel.com/pricing): Hobby / $20 Pro / Enterprise. [Lovable pricing](https://lovable.dev/pricing): Free / $25 Pro (most popular) / $50 Business / Enterprise.

Rules:
- **Free, not trial.** Every winner offers free-forever with hard limits. "Free trial" reads as 2019.
- **Annual default ON, with monthly toggle.** Linear, Lovable bill yearly by default.
- **3rd tier highlighted "Most Popular"** with color/scale (Linear Business, Lovable Pro, Cursor Pro+).
- **Enterprise = "Contact sales"** never a price. Always a "Book a demo" or "Talk to sales" button.
- **Per-seat for collab tools, usage credits for AI-heavy.** Lovable uses credits; Linear uses seats; brocco.ai should hybrid (seat + agent-run credits).

## 5. CTA copy that converts

- **Primary verbs in 2026:** "Start building," "Start free," "Deploy," "Get started," "Try free." NOT "Sign up," "Learn more," "Submit."
- **No time-bound trials in CTA copy.** "Try free for 14 days" is dated. Free-tier-forever wins.
- **Secondary CTA = sales/demo.** "Talk to sales," "Book a demo," "Contact sales."
- **Personalized CTAs convert 202% better** ([fibr.ai](https://fibr.ai/landing-page/saas-landing-pages)) — match copy to traffic source (e.g., "Start automating your ops" for ops-team ads).
- **One primary per fold.** Repeat the SAME primary CTA in hero, mid-page, and footer. Don't introduce new verbs.

## 6. Trust signals

Required for SMB-and-up: SOC 2 Type II badge (Cursor footer; Relevance hero). For agent platforms specifically: GDPR, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit logs, data residency. Logos grid of 6–12 customers. Integrations grid (Relevance shows 100+ across 1,000+ apps). GitHub stars only matter if you're dev-tool open-source. No "5-star" star ratings unless tied to G2/Capterra with link.

## 7. FAQ patterns

6–10 questions, accordion, near the bottom above final CTA. Address: pricing edge cases, data privacy/training, cancellation, integrations, "do I need to know X to use this," migration from competitor. DO NOT address: speculative future features, AI-doom anxieties, comparisons by name to specific competitors (do that on a separate /vs page). Keep each answer under 60 words.

## 8. Mobile

**Drop:** complex animated SVG agent demos (use a static screenshot + one looping 4-sec clip), full pricing comparison table (collapse to tabs by tier), nav links beyond Login + primary CTA. **Keep:** hero headline (recompose to 2 lines max), primary CTA sticky-bottom, social proof logos as horizontal scroll, one testimonial, FAQ. Lovable's mobile = chat box hero is the gold standard.

# Prescriptive site spec — brocco.ai

**Positioning:** "Agents wired into your business. Not chatbots."
**Buyer:** SMB owner / solo founder / 2–10 person ops team.
**Charter pitch:** Claude-native runtime + multi-agent orchestrator + tool registry, glued to YOUR proprietary workflows (Schmidt moat).

### Section-by-section

**1. Hero**
- Headline: **"Agents that do your work. Not chatbots that talk about it."**
- Subhead: "Brocco wires Claude-powered agents into your tools, your data, your SOPs — so they ship work, not summaries."
- Primary CTA: **"Start free"** (no card, 100 agent runs/mo)
- Secondary CTA: **"Book a demo"**
- Motion: looping 10-sec capture of an agent receiving a Slack message → reading from a Google Sheet → drafting an email → posting to Asana. Show the tool calls inline. NO talking head.

**2. Logo strip + outcome bar (above fold-2)**
- 4-6 design partner logos. If none yet, run "Built by the team behind [prior projects]" with one quantified result.
- One number: "X workflows automated this week" (live counter from your pipeline if possible).

**3. "How it works" — 3 cards, scroll-snapped**
1. Connect your tools (Stripe, Gmail, Notion, Slack, Shopify, custom APIs)
2. Describe the workflow in plain English
3. The agent runs on a trigger or schedule — every time, forever

**4. Agent showcase — "Watch one run"**
Embedded interactive demo. User picks a vertical (Detroit-style real estate ops / DTC ops / agency ops) and watches a real agent execute end-to-end. This is the Lovable-style differentiator.

**5. Moat section: "Wired into YOUR business"**
The Schmidt thesis explicit: "Generic chatbots can't access your CRM, your sheets, your SOPs. Brocco's tool registry connects agents to the proprietary workflows that actually run your company." Show a tool-registry screenshot with custom integrations.

**6. Testimonials** (3 named, with company + role + 1 metric each)

**7. Pricing — 4 tiers, annual default, monthly toggle**
| Tier | Price | Limit | CTA |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | 100 runs/mo, 1 agent | "Start free" |
| Solo | **$49/mo** | 2,000 runs, 5 agents, all integrations | "Start free trial" |
| Team **(MOST POPULAR)** | **$199/mo** | 10,000 runs, unlimited agents, 5 seats, SSO | "Start free trial" |
| Enterprise | Custom | SOC2 report, SSO/SCIM, dedicated support, on-prem option | "Talk to sales" |

Highlight Team with brand color border + "Most Popular" pill. Annual = 2 months free.

**8. Trust row**
SOC 2 Type II (in progress badge OK), GDPR, "Your data is never used to train models," 99.9% uptime, encrypted at rest. Link to /security page.

**9. Integrations grid**
Logo grid of 30+ integrations: Stripe, Gmail, Slack, Notion, Asana, Linear, HubSpot, Shopify, Twilio, Postgres, Webhooks, Zapier-bridge, custom HTTP. "Don't see yours? Build a custom tool in 5 min."

**10. FAQ — 8 questions**
Pricing overage, data privacy (do you train on my data? NO), cancellation (anytime, prorated), supported models (Claude Opus/Sonnet/Haiku), self-host availability (Enterprise), Zapier vs Brocco (Zapier is triggers; Brocco reasons), how long to first agent (15 min), security/SOC2.

**11. Final CTA band**
Full-bleed: **"Stop hiring chatbots. Start shipping work."** + "Start free" + "Book a demo."

**12. Mobile cuts**
Drop: integrations grid (collapse to "30+ integrations →" link), pricing table (tabs), interactive demo (replace with 6-sec looping capture). Keep: hero, logo strip, one testimonial, pricing tabs, FAQ, sticky bottom "Start free."
